name: interaction-sweep-walk
note: WALK-mode clips. Default 4-room flat: walk spawn (11, 7.5) yaw ~0.07 (yaw 0 faces -Z / north up the living-dining; yaw +pi/2 faces -X / west). Kitchen x=[6.08,10.10] z=[6.98,9.08]; the service-yard door is on its west wall at x=6.075.

clips.name: walk-forward-back
clips.note: W then S along the long axis

clips.name: walk-look-drag-while-moving
clips.note: HARNESS LIMIT: desktop look needs Pointer Lock, unavailable headless — this clip shows what a user's click+drag+W actually does without the lock

clips.name: walk-into-wall-slide
clips.note: hold W into the north wall, then strafe to slide along it

clips.name: walk-lights-mid-walk
clips.note: setLightsMode on/off WHILE walking — z16 LIGHTS-TOGGLE-RECOMPILE is expected here

ops.js: (async () => { const s = window.__store.getState(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1100)); s.setLightsMode('on'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1400)); s.setLightsMode('off') })()

clips.name: walk-orbit-switch-mid-gesture
clips.note: orbit rotate held, cameraMode flips to walk and back under the live gesture (the store value is 'firstPerson' — 'walk' is not a CameraMode, see cameraSlice.ts:CAMERA_MODES)

ops.js: (async () => { const s = window.__store.getState(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); s.setCameraMode('firstPerson'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); s.setCameraMode('orbit') })()

clips.name: walk-phone-look-only
clips.note: pure look drag, full 360 sweep — wall-reveal + shadow refresh under a rotation-only camera
